question: What special transmission leads to sharing in siddhi rather than the ordinary outcome?
premises: Transmission occurs from mouth to mouth.
This mode is marked as special.
An alternative ordinary outcome is contrasted.
inference: Especially through mouth-to-mouth transmission one shares in siddhi; otherwise it is ordinary.
uncertainties: The exact parsing of samānyathā as a fused form is interpretive.
plain_english: Especially from mouth to mouth, one partakes of siddhi; otherwise it is ordinary.
